recommendation: Keep the fix as-is; it aligns Signature guidance with the final scoped MIME-type decision and does not require broader terminology changes.
issue_request: FHIR-48679 asked to resolve invalid MIME type handling where CapabilityStatement.format allowed xml/json/ttl although those are not in ValueSet/mimetypes; the Applied resolution creates Supplemented MIME Types for CapabilityStatement.format and avoids allowing short-form codes at all other MIME type uses.
initial_application: Commit 41d77c5f67 added supplemented-mimetypes and simple-format-codes and changed CapabilityStatement.format to bind to ValueSet/supplemented-mimetypes; commit bc59d05446 later added OID/identifier data. That left a copied xml/json/ttl allowance comment in the active Signature datatype source.
additional_context: FHIR-20617 explains why CapabilityStatement.format is special. FHIR-I minutes record the FHIR-48679 vote, and the Zulip validator discussion confirms that adding xml/json/ttl to the plain MIME Types value set globally was not the chosen solution.
reconciliation: Changed source/datatypes/signature.xml by clearing the stale Signature.targetFormat comment that said xml/json/ttl are allowed. The existing CapabilityStatement.format supplemented binding and MIME-only bindings elsewhere were preserved.
source_changes: source/datatypes/signature.xml: removed the stale Signature.targetFormat comment that allowed xml/json/ttl short-form codes while the element remains bound to MimeType.

related_jiras.note: Earlier CapabilityStatement.format binding issue that introduced the short-form format-code handling later scoped by FHIR-48679.

evidence_items.summary: Applied/Persuasive correction requesting a supplemented MIME value set for CapabilityStatement.format and explicitly not allowing short-form xml/json/ttl codes at other MIME type uses.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes both the required CapabilityStatement.format binding and the need to remove contradictory Signature guidance.

evidence_items.summary: Signature is active/normative, simple-format-codes and supplemented-mimetypes are active source entries, supplemented-mimetypes includes BCP-13 plus simple-format-codes, and CapabilityStatement.format binds to ValueSet/supplemented-mimetypes.
evidence_items.learned: The main FHIR-48679 terminology change is in current build scope and already applied correctly.
